attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: game_and_schedule_management
steps:
  - id: receive_game_form
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/api/games/scheduling-form"
    output: raw_game_form

  - id: authenticate_admin
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "admin"
    output: auth_result

  - id: validate_game_form
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_game_form
      schema:
        type: object
        required:
          - home_team
          - away_team
          - league
          - date
          - time
          - venue
        properties:
          home_team:
            type: string
          away_team:
            type: string
          league:
            type: string
          date:
            type: string
            format: date
          time:
            type: string
          venue:
            type: string
    output: validated_game_form

  - id: extract_league
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      field: "league"
    output: league_id

  - id: fetch_league_teams
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: "teams"
      filter:
        league: league_id
    output: raw_league_teams

  - id: validate_league_teams
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_league_teams
      schema:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          required:
            - team_id
            - league
    output: league_teams

  - id: check_teams_belong_to_league
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "both home_team and away_team from validated_game_form must exist in league_teams"
      input_form: validated_game_form
      input_teams: league_teams
    output: league_membership_result

  - id: route_on_membership
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "league_membership_result == true"
      on_true: fetch_existing_games
      on_false: terminate_membership_failure

  - id: terminate_membership_failure
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      reason: "One or both teams do not belong to the specified league"

  - id: fetch_existing_games
    op: read_database
    params:
      table: "games"
      filter:
        teams:
          - home_team
          - away_team
        date: validated_game_form.date
    output: raw_existing_games

  - id: validate_existing_games
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_existing_games
      schema:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            game_id:
              type: string
            home_team:
              type: string
            away_team:
              type: string
            date:
              type: string
    output: existing_games

  - id: apply_conflict_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      rule: "no game in existing_games should involve home_team or away_team on the same date"
      existing: existing_games
      new_game: validated_game_form
    output: conflict_check_result

  - id: route_on_conflict
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "conflict_check_result.has_conflict == false"
      on_true: prepare_game_record
      on_false: terminate_conflict_failure

  - id: terminate_conflict_failure
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "failed"
      reason: "Scheduling conflict detected: a team already has a game on the specified date"

  - id: prepare_game_record
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: validated_game_form
      mapping:
        home_team: "$.home_team"
        away_team: "$.away_team"
        league: "$.league"
        date: "$.date"
        time: "$.time"
        venue: "$.venue"
        status: "scheduled"
    output: game_record

  - id: insert_game_record
    op: write_database
    params:
      input: game_record
      table: "games"
    output: write_result

  - id: log_game_creation
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: game_record
      action: "game_scheduled"
      performed_by: auth_result

  - id: notify_admin_success
    op: notify_user
    params:
      input: game_record
      recipient: auth_result
      message: "Game successfully scheduled"

  - id: terminate_success
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      status: "completed"
      result: write_result
